title: Deliverable
description: A concrete output produced by an activity, submitted for review. See docs/protocol/04-terminology.md.

activityId.description: The activity this deliverable was produced by, if any.

artifactType.description: Free-form type of the underlying artifact (e.g. 'document', 'pull-request', 'inspection-report').

acceptanceCriteria.description: Human-readable criteria the deliverable must satisfy to be accepted.
